SPRINTERVALS (Sprint Intervals) are a brilliant drill to help you get more runs and take more wickets by improving your cricket fitness.
They focus on your speed and stamina, both critical for cricket fitness, allowing you to turn 1’s into 2’s when batting and bowling longer spells.
Set up 2 markers, 20 meters apart. Sprint from
one cone to the next (holding a cricket bat for extra cricket feel) for 30 seconds. Then rest for 30 seconds. Repeat for 10 rounds.
